channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Wiseman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Wiseman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
“James Wiseman was getting beaten up on social media and I went to him and I said 'Hey, let's get off social media together.'So we did it, and I figured it would be, you know, a month or two and I would go back, because I did enjoy a lot of it in terms of the newsfeed on Twitter and just following people that I like to follow, and then I realized after a couple weeks how great it was, that I didn't actually miss it and that I could just do the navigation on my own and find stuff that I wanted to read but avoid a lot of the toxic stuff.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Mar 5, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Monty Williams on Jalen Duren/James Wiseman:

“You could have a situation where there's tension, those guys work together every day. They compete against each other. At times, they get physical & it's competitive... I think they have an appreciation for what Wise has been through.”

Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Jalen Duren, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Wiseman
item.description:
Monty on Wiseman:

“His approach is tremendous and I think that allows for him to have these kinds of nights. If he were a guy who's emotionally unstable, it would be harder for him because he didn't get the consistent minutes early this season ... you're seeing that work pay off”

Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Mar 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Wiseman
item.description:
Monty Williams on how Wiseman has handled his role:

“The best of anyboy on our team... He has the best attitude. He comes in and works hard. He's not happy when he doesn't play, but I like that... I just love his approach with everything that has been said about him at that pick.”

Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Mar 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Wiseman
item.description:
Monty on expectations for Wiseman:

“I just want him to be consistent. The effort is always there. Communication in defense is improving. We love his presence in pick-and-rolls. We just want to see consistency.”

Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Mar 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Wiseman
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Monty on Wiseman:

“He just works. He gets better every time he steps on the floor. We had conversations about him playing hard and just being smarter about fouls. But I just want him to hoop.”

Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Dec 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Klay Thompson on James Wiseman
item.description:
Klay Thompson on being reunited for former teammate James Wiseman:

“It will be great to see James. We spent many, many days rehabbing together... I think about him often and hope he's doing well... I consider James a dear friend, so it will be great to see him and catch up.”

Klay Thompson on James Wiseman, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Warriors coachSteve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“Looking forward to seeing James… Always pulling for him. Everyone takes a different path and his path hasn’t gone the way we’ve all thought it would, but he still has lots of potential. He just needs to keep working and keep growing.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Klay Thompson on James Wiseman
item.description:
Dalton Johnson:Klay Thompson on James Wiseman:

“I just know he's going to be a heck of a player in this league. ... I'm going to miss him.”

Klay Thompson on James Wiseman, Feb 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaltonJ_Johnson.

item.title: Bob Myers on James Wiseman
item.description:
KNBR: Bob Myers on trading James Wiseman:

“I think we debated it pretty heavily. Mostly because I still believe he can be a good player. It may just be that his path required more minutes than we were able to give him. It may be that his (timeline) is longer than we can wait.”

Bob Myers on James Wiseman, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Kerr on James Wiseman:

“Between the injuries and inexperience, coming to a team like ours that’s fighting for championships and playing with a group that’s been together for a long time,it was difficult for me to give James the runway he needed.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“I was all in on (drafting) James when we did. I was part of the group, loved the ability, loved everything that we saw.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Troy Weaver on James Wiseman
item.description:
Troy Weaver on the start to Wiseman's career/upside potential:

“It's simple: during the evaluation process of a player, you look for certain things. He has all of the ingredients that we look for in a person first and then, as a player, has tremendous upside.”

Troy Weaver on James Wiseman, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
“A couple years ago, I went to James Wiseman and I asked him how he was doing with the social media stuff and he goes, 'Yeah, it’s a little tough,''”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Dec 21, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Jordan Poole on James Wiseman
item.description:
Jordan Poole on James Wiseman going to the G-League (which Poole once did):

“I told him it’s not a demotion. It’s not a punishment. He’s going to go down there and shoot as many shots as he wants, get as many touches as he wants, work on as many moves as he wants.”

Jordan Poole on James Wiseman, Nov 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Madeline Kenney:Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“It's gonna take a lot of reps and time. But I see a really talented young guy who's eager to learn,who is committed to the team, who has overcome an awful lot to get to this point, dealing with his injury for over a year.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Nov 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @madkenney.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Steve Kerr on James Wiseman’s performance tonight:

“He just has a better sense of the NBA game now compared to where he was… To see him rewarded in the first preseason game was fantastic.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Sep 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.

item.title: Bob Myers on James Wiseman
item.description:
Bob Myers on James Wiseman:

“We track the pickup games, and he's the only one in the facility that played in every one... There's no swelling, and we're happy that he's healthy. Now he can start the work.”

Bob Myers on James Wiseman, Sep 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody
item.description:
to coach Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jonathan Kuminga and Moses Moody getting more minutes next season :

“Sure, we'll like it. But if there are guys playing better, we'll play those guys.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody, Jun 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on the plan for James Wiseman:

“I feel terrible for James. The hope was that he would play tomorrow in Santa Cruz. That's not going to happen.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Mar 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Stephen Curry on James Wiseman
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Stephen Curry on James Wiseman:

“He's a beast when you look at him on the floor, especially with the rest of our team… He can do some amazing things. It's just a matter of him getting comfortable and getting those reps. So thats a good step in terms of his come back.”

Stephen Curry on James Wiseman, Feb 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Steve Kerr on James Wiseman at practice today:

“It's just great to see him back out on the floor, seeing him smiling, seeing him happy. It's all good stuff, but we'll just keep taking it a day at a time. No proclamations, no plans beyond the next day, and we'll go from there.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Feb 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Damion Lee on James Wiseman
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Damion Lee on James Wiseman working out with the team today:

“That was a good step for him. ... For him to be back on the court, it was great.”

Damion Lee on James Wiseman, Feb 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“There's a chance that he could be playing come playoff time. We don't really know what to expect.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Feb 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“This has just not been an easy one to figure out. We're still hopeful he'll be cleared for contact soon,but there hasn't been an opportunity for that to happen this week.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, James Wiseman, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody
item.description:
“We had a great last decade and our goal is to set ourselves up for another great decade. We’ve got Steph, Klay and Draymond for the next several years at a high level, hopefully longer. [Andrew] Wiggins is only 26. With [Jordan] Poole, [James] Wiseman, [Jonathan] Kuminga and [Moses] Moody, we’ve got a lot of talent to develop and a lot of work to do, but we’re pretty excited.”

Joe Lacob on Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, James Wiseman, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody, Jan 10, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“We're hopeful on the road trip next week he can really ramp up the contact.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jan 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Bob Myers on LaMelo Ball, James Wiseman
item.description:
What the pair only have in common at this point?–they were both the top players on the Warriors’ radar at the time.

“We targeted James [Wiseman,] obviously we took him in front of LaMelo [Ball],”

Bob Myers on LaMelo Ball, James Wiseman, Dec 19, 2021. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“We’ve been purposely deliberate the last couple of months and just slowly ramping things up. He’s moving well and engaged in a lot of drill work in practice and doing 5-0 stuff. He’s getting a lot of work in, and he’s feeling good.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Nov 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on James Wiseman:

“I think it's just been a gradual improvement over time... This is something that we're obviously taking very seriously and taking very slowly. The good thing is he advanced from his individual work to do all the team stuff other than the scrimmaging.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Nov 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.
